Upstream TinyCC baseline vendored for CPrime compile-speed comparisons.

Source: https://github.com/TinyCC/tinycc.git
Commit: 2ba12e83b3599ca8f5d50c179fe5138fe956f0c9
Version file: 0.9.28rc

This tree is intended to stay close to raw upstream tcc. Do not apply CPrime
language-extension changes here; use it as the C-only speed baseline.
